gaps.lead: At no time did we think that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.sentence: It ___ that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.hint: it occurred to sb = sb thought
gaps.explanation: 'At no time did we think' becomes 'it never occurred to us'.

gaps.lead: He jogged every morning when he was younger.
gaps.sentence: He ___ every morning when he was younger.
gaps.explanation: 'Used to + infinitive' describes a past habit.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: The committee probably won't change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: probably won't = it is (highly) unlikely that.

gaps.lead: I'd prefer it if you arrived before eight.
gaps.explanation: would rather + subject + past simple for other people's actions.
